ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-ratio of white-to-black pixels (approximately 0.2:1); high local contrast between dark primary pigment and high-intensity white scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) base across both lobes; contiguous high-intensity (white) clusters at both distal tips; high-frequency stochastic white focal spots (1-5 pixel radius) distributed across the medial and lateral planes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees; notch depth is deep relative to the lobe-width-to-height ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern; irregular jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude 3-8 pixels) along the continuous linear boundary, more pronounced on the left lobe medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic sweep along the trailing edge boundary, tapering to pointed distal tips that curve slightly upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular high-contrast pixel clusters localized on the distal right lobe and scattered along the upper margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of overlapping, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 10 to 60 pixels in length, covering approximately 60% of the visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cicatrization and physical trauma markers on both distal tips; heavy linear rake-mark scarring suggesting intense interaction history.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique starburst-shaped intersection of four high-contrast linear abrasions located in the lower-center region of the right lobe.
